_help: Per-format answers the Creator Skill Pack asks at setup; your brand comes from config/profile.json. Edit a value here or override it under "skills" in config/profile.json, then: python tools/import_formats.py --refill
proof_dir: none (fetch real pages and screenshots, list every source)
